messi: Lionel Messi has won the Ballon d'Or eight times, more than any other player.
Messi scored 91 goals in 2012, the most ever in a calendar year.
Messi captained Argentina to the 2022 World Cup and won the Golden Ball.
Messi is Barcelona's all-time top scorer, with 672 goals.
barca: Camp Nou opened in 1957 and held about 99,000 fans before its rebuild.
Barça's motto, "Més que un club", means "more than a club".
In 2009 Barcelona won six trophies in one calendar year, the first sextuple.
kohli: Virat Kohli was the first batter to score 50 ODI centuries, in the 2023 World Cup semi-final.
Kohli scored 765 runs at the 2023 World Cup, the most by anyone at a single World Cup.
Kohli captained India to the Under-19 World Cup title in 2008.
rohit: Rohit Sharma's 264 against Sri Lanka in 2014 is the highest score in ODI cricket.
Rohit is the only batter with three ODI double centuries.
Rohit captained India to the 2024 T20 World Cup title.
Rohit has led Mumbai Indians to five IPL titles.
onepiece: One Piece has sold over 500 million copies worldwide.
One Piece began in Weekly Shōnen Jump in 1997.
Luffy's dream is to become King of the Pirates.
naruto: Naruto ran in Weekly Shōnen Jump from 1999 to 2014, for 700 chapters.
Kakashi Hatake went on to become the Sixth Hokage.
dbz: Dragon Ball began in 1984, created by Akira Toriyama.
The Kamehameha is named after Kamehameha I, the king who united Hawaii.
jjk: Jujutsu Kaisen began in Weekly Shōnen Jump in 2018.
ds: Demon Slayer: Mugen Train became the highest-grossing film ever in Japan in 2020.
Shinobu Kocho fights with poison, because she is not strong enough to behead demons.
aot: Attack on Titan ran in Bessatsu Shōnen Magazine from 2009 to 2021.
Levi leads the Survey Corps' Special Operations Squad.
bleach: Bleach ran in Weekly Shōnen Jump from 2001 to 2016.
Thousand-Year Blood War adapts Bleach's final arc.
solo: Solo Leveling began as a Korean web novel by Chugong in 2016.
The Solo Leveling anime premiered in January 2024.
opm: One-Punch Man began as a webcomic by ONE in 2009.
Saitama says his training was 100 push-ups, 100 sit-ups, 100 squats and a 10 km run, every day.
tech: The first computer "bug" was a real moth, found in a Harvard computer in 1947.
JavaScript was written in about ten days in 1995.
Android is built on the Linux kernel, so this TV runs Linux.
Every one of the world's 500 fastest supercomputers runs Linux.
hiking: The Western Ghats, home of the Sahyadris, became a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2012.
sachin: Sachin Tendulkar scored 100 international centuries, more than anyone else.
Sachin was the first man to score a double century in an ODI, against South Africa in 2010.
In 1998 at Sharjah, Sachin hit two centuries in three days through a sandstorm: the "Desert Storm".
Sachin played 200 Test matches, the most by any cricketer.
Sachin won the World Cup in 2011 at Wankhede, his home ground, in his sixth World Cup.
yamal: Lamine Yamal came through La Masia, Barça's academy.
Yamal won Euro 2024 with Spain at 17, and was named its best young player.
Yamal celebrates with "304", the end of the postcode of Rocafonda, the part of Mataró he grew up in.
Yamal took Barça's number 10 shirt in 2025.
Raphinha and Yamal play on opposite wings: Raphinha on the left, Yamal on the right.
